stone_lore.name: Stone Lore
stone_lore.description: Teach your swarms to sift shattered bricks with purpose, increasing stone drawn from debris.

stone_automatons.name: Stone Automatons
stone_automatons.description: Bind mindless servitors to repeat simple rites for you, enabling basic ritual automation.

autorestart_rituals.name: Autorestart Sigils
autorestart_rituals.description: Allows the map to automatically restart after completion or defeat.
autorestart_rituals.registerEventText: Sigils now repeat the ritual unbidden.

construction_guild.name: Construction Guild
construction_guild.description: Found a guild to coordinate permanent worksites, unlocking dedicated building plans.
construction_guild.registerEventText: A permanent guild answers your call.

construction_ledgers.name: Construction Ledgers
construction_ledgers.description: Account every shard and shipment; precision cuts future building costs.

draftsmanship.name: Draftsmanship
draftsmanship.description: Refine schematics to unlock access to new building blueprints.

crafting_blueprints.name: Crafting Blueprints
crafting_blueprints.description: Archive optimized cut lists and material yields—each tier stretches workshop stockpiles further.

quarry_overseers.name: Quarry Overseers
quarry_overseers.description: Assign tireless haulers so rubble never settles—more stone per shattered brick.

granite_bonding.name: Granite Bonding
granite_bonding.description: Fuse matter into denser cores your summons can wield—every strike lands heavier.

bastion_foundations.name: Bastion Foundations
bastion_foundations.description: Build mental fortifications—deeper foundations of consciousness allow you to maintain presence on the map longer.

sand_scribing.name: Sand Scribing
sand_scribing.description: Etch careful scribing to strain the stream of sand, expanding mana reserves.

glass_latticework.name: Glass Latticework
glass_latticework.description: Weave emberglass filaments that steady your focus, modestly improving mana flow.

arcane_amplifier.name: Arcane Amplifier
arcane_amplifier.description: Tune the lattice into a resonant chamber, amplifying the force carried by your spells.

sandstorm_ritual.name: Sandstorm Ritual
sandstorm_ritual.description: Bind the lattice to desert winds, unlocking the rite to conjure devastating sand storms.

black_darts.name: Darts of the Void
black_darts.description: Unleash darts of metal and void energy that damage targets.

electric_shards.name: Electric Shards
electric_shards.description: Crackle the lattice with unstable sparks, unlocking erratic shards of electricity.

ring_of_fire.name: Ring of Fire
ring_of_fire.description: Weave a barrier of flame that erupts outward, searing everything it brushes.

sharp_mind.name: Sharp Mind
sharp_mind.description: Increase spell power by 12% per level.

sharp_mind2.name: Sharp Mind II
sharp_mind2.description: Increase spell power by 12% per level.

magic_rain.name: Magic Rain
magic_rain.description: Unleash powerful bolts of arcane energy that rain down on your enemies.

void_modules.name: Chord
void_modules.description: Imprint a structural chord into your entities, enabling attachment of organs and parts.
void_modules.registerEventText: A chord resonates for organs and parts.

tail_spines.name: Tail Spines
tail_spines.description: Graft barbed spines along the chord, enabling sideways volleys from attached quills.

pheromones.name: Pheromones
pheromones.description: Seed your chord lattice with signal glands so your beasts can coordinate through scent and surge.

ice_mastery.name: Ice Mastery
ice_mastery.description: Master the art of ice magic, allowing you to freeze enemies.

fire_mastery.name: Fire Mastery
fire_mastery.description: Master the art of fire magic.

radiation_control.name: Radiation Control
radiation_control.description: Unlocks new organs that fuse Darwinian evolution, radiation, and a touch of magic.

emberglass_reactors.name: Emberglass Reactors
emberglass_reactors.description: Channel heat through mirrored chambers; surging sand becomes lasting mana stores.

improved_membranes.name: Improved Membranes
improved_membranes.description: Stiffen ephemeral skins into resilient membranes—your entities endure more.

hunger.name: Hunger
hunger.description: A gnawing void urges you on. Feed it with matter so your summons strike harder.

muscles.name: Muscles
muscles.description: Strengthen the fibres that drive motion—your summons gain faster acceleration (+5% per level).

stone_drill.name: Stone Teeth
stone_drill.description: Affix crude teeth to the forming shells of your entities, boosting their assault.

stone_armor.name: Stone Armor
stone_armor.description: Layer stone scales over pulsing forms—basic protection that turns glancing blows.

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.description: Grow thicker layers of living matter around your cores, raising total vitality.

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.description: Quiet the inner static. Clearer thought and mental clarity extend your ability to remain conscious on the map.

clarity2.name: Clarity II
clarity2.description: Deeper stillness and mental discipline further expand your consciousness, allowing extended presence on the map.

mana_source.name: Mana Source
mana_source.description: Tap a steadier vein of power—both reserves and recovery improve.

mana_reservior.name: Mana Reservoir
mana_reservior.description: Shape capacitors of fused glass to store greater tides of mana.

critical_chance.name: Critical Chance
critical_chance.description: Sharpen instincts and edges alike—your units find weak points more often.

critical_chance2.name: Critical Chance II
critical_chance2.description: Deeper instincts and edges—your units find weak points more often.

damage_lore.name: Damage Lore
damage_lore.description: Codices of rending—teach your creations how to tear matter more efficiently.

armor_lore.name: Armor Lore
armor_lore.description: Treatises on layering and bracing—improve how well armor spreads force.

impact_dampening.name: Impact Dampening
impact_dampening.description: Elastic tissues absorb impacts, reducing knockback.

vitality2.name: Vitality II
vitality2.description: Cultivate richer biomass; the flesh‑cores swell with fresh reserves.

clarity3.name: Clarity III
clarity3.description: Mastery of mental focus—your consciousness remains unshaken, enabling you to persist on the map even when the void whispers.

refinement.name: Refinement
refinement.description: Refine sorting rites; your gatherers pull richer fragments from the wreckage.

refinement2.name: Refinement II
refinement2.description: Further hone refinement patterns to squeeze even more yield from debris.

wire_crafting.name: Wire Crafting
wire_crafting.description: Unlock access to wire crafting, allowing you to create more organs and buildings out of your materials.

vitality3.name: Vitality III
vitality3.description: Refined organs and redundant tissue markedly raise your creations' resilience.

vitality4.name: Vitality IV
vitality4.description: Use coal to boost creatures body temperature, increase metabolism and increase vitality.

titanium_bones.name: Titanium Bones
titanium_bones.description: Use titanium to build a powerful skeleton.

arcane_research.name: Arcane Research
arcane_research.description: Document repeatable mana experiments; each insight slightly accelerates regen.

paper_milling.name: Paper Milling
paper_milling.description: Pulp organics into disciplined sheets fit for resilient schematics.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.description: Teach your creations to knit themselves mid‑battle—steady percentage regen.

engineered_plating.name: Reinforced Carapace
engineered_plating.description: Craft and graft reinforced plating onto your creations—substantial increase to health.

armor_lore2.name: Armor Lore II
armor_lore2.description: Advanced schemata: ribbing, overlaps, anchor points—denser protection.

armor_lore3.name: Armor Lore III
armor_lore3.description: Master forging of living plate—your hosts shrug off punishing blows.

reinforced_silver_armor.name: Reinforced Silver Armor
reinforced_silver_armor.description: Layer silvered scales with resilient supports, amplifying protection.

armor_lore4.name: Armor Lore IV
armor_lore4.description: Master forging of living plate—your hosts shrug off punishing blows.

heavy_drill.name: Heavy Fangs
heavy_drill.description: Craft and implant dense, weighty fangs—mass and drive make every strike land harder.

tool_fabrication.name: Tool Fabrication
tool_fabrication.description: Craft specialized implements and implants, unlocking advanced crafting.

forged_strikes.name: Forged Strikes
forged_strikes.description: Forge and implant hardened strikers—your vanguard's strikes hit harder.

silver_drill.name: Silver Fangs
silver_drill.description: Craft silvered fang-implants that bite deeper into matter, amplifying your creatures' attacks.

uranium_mitochondria.name: Uranium Mitochondria
uranium_mitochondria.description: Metabolism accelerated by a new radioactive element pushes your jaw-muscle power to another level.

penetration.name: Penetration
penetration.description: Sharpen fangs and angle of strike—your creatures pierce tougher shells.

penetration2.name: Penetration II
penetration2.description: Refine implant geometry—even plated foes yield to your creatures' bite.

wire_penetration.name: Piercing Fangs
wire_penetration.description: Craft conductive fang-implants that sharpen your creatures' bite against armor.

penetration3.name: Penetration III
penetration3.description: Use hot magma to melt through armor.

soul_wood.name: Soul Wood
soul_wood.description: Coax living grain to host stored power, expanding your mana capacity.

advanced_construction.name: Advanced Construction
advanced_construction.description: Codify advanced methods for large works—foundation for superior structures.

consiousness.name: Consciousness
consiousness.description: Strengthen your mental fortitude, expanding the limits of your consciousness to endure longer on the map.

weaken_curse.name: Weaken Curse
weaken_curse.description: Unlock the Weaken Curse spell to sap bricks' strength and dampen their blows.

perseverance.name: Perseverance
perseverance.description: Increase the health of your units by 1% per maximum map level cleared per level.

inspiration.name: Inspiration
inspiration.description: Increase the damage of your units by 1% per map levels cleared per level.

souls_harvest.name: Souls Harvest
souls_harvest.description: Harvest souls from defeated living enemies (not turrets) and use them in your dark experiments.
souls_harvest.registerEventText: Whispers of Dark Research answer your harvest.

intensive_motion.name: Intensive Motion
intensive_motion.description: Train your summons for intense bursts of motion (+5% acceleration per level).

intensive_motion2.name: Intensive Motion II
intensive_motion2.description: Layer advanced motion patterns for even faster acceleration (+5% per level).
